invariants.rationale: Padding values (such as padTop) are often expected to be non-negative in UI layout code.
float values passed as arguments are bounded above by Float.MAX_VALUE.
Reflexivity holds for float arguments; however, this checks for padTop not being NaN, as NaN != NaN.
Padding with NaN would be unexpected; typically, UI code expects valid floats, not NaN.
Equivalent to padTop >= 0, expressing that negative padding is usually not intended.
